name: coding-harness
description: Safe Harness Bootstrap for repository-local agent instructions, wiki, validation, and handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Install and validate a safe repository-local Harness.
interface.longDescription: Coding Harness provides V1-safe init, audit, wiki, doctor, and handoff workflows for agent-friendly repositories. It does not run dynamic workflows or dispatch subagents.
interface.defaultPrompt: Initialize or audit a repository-local Coding Harness.
